caption: Choosing a highlight list
preconditions: Seeded newsroom (tools/screenshots/seed.py), including highlights 'Top Stories' (now/d) and 'Election Watch' (now/w) on Politics (HIGHLIGHTS). The snapshot's 'Highlight 1' belongs to another desk.
steps: open #/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'
wait until [data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="Politics / Working"] contains at least one [data-test-id="article-item"]
hover (#highlightPackage button.dropdown__toggle) so the hover dropdown opens
wait for (#highlightPackage .dropdown__menu) to show 'Top Stories'
notes: Replaces the inline base64 Highlights icon and 'image38'. The Workspace Panel entry is rendered from scripts/apps/highlights/views/menu.html and package_highlights_dropdown_directive.html: aria-label 'Highlights', no data-test-id, menu label 'Choose highlight list'. The dropdown has class dropdown--hover; if hovering does not open it, click the toggle. Only highlights assigned to the current desk are listed, so Politics must be selected. Remove the two highlights afterwards (DELETE /api/highlights/<id>) or restore the snapshot; marks on items are left behind otherwise.

caption: Adding an article to a highlight
preconditions: Seeded newsroom (tools/screenshots/seed.py), including highlights 'Top Stories' (now/d) and 'Election Watch' (now/w) on Politics (HIGHLIGHTS). The snapshot's 'Highlight 1' belongs to another desk.
Admin has the mark_for_highlights privilege (admin has all privileges)
steps: open #/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'
hover [data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="Politics / Working"] [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Defence ministry delays patrol vessel order by a year"]
click [data-test-id="context-menu-button"] inside that item
wait for [data-test-id="context-menu"] to be visible
hover the button with role=button name 'Mark for highlight' inside [data-test-id="context-menu"] so the submenu opens
wait for the submenu to show 'Top Stories' and 'Election Watch'

plus: [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Defence ministry delays patrol vessel order by a year"]

notes: Replaces 's-highlightactions.png', 's-terminologyguide5.png' and 'image218'. 'Mark for highlight' is the mark.item activity (scripts/apps/highlights/index.ts, star icon, group 'highlights'); its submenu is HighlightsReactDropdown and opens on mouseenter, possibly to the left of the menu. Do not click a highlight, that would mark the item. Only text items on a desk the user belongs to get the entry. Remove the two highlights afterwards (DELETE /api/highlights/<id>) or restore the snapshot; marks on items are left behind otherwise.

caption: The star shows that an article is in a highlight
preconditions: Seeded newsroom (tools/screenshots/seed.py), including highlights 'Top Stories' (now/d) and 'Election Watch' (now/w) on Politics (HIGHLIGHTS). The snapshot's 'Highlight 1' belongs to another desk.

Marks seeded by seed.py (HIGHLIGHT_MARKS): COUNCIL-TRANSIT in Top Stories and Election Watch, MINISTER-RESIGNS in Top Stories. ELECTION-BUDGET is deliberately left unmarked (a marked item shows a star in its authoring header, and many other pages open that story)
steps: open #/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'
wait until [data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="Politics / Working"] contains at least one [data-test-id="highlights-indicator"]
move the mouse away from the list so no row is hovered
highlight: [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Arlenport council approves tram extension to eastern suburbs"] [data-test-id="highlights-indicator"]
notes: Replaces 'image64', which had a hand-drawn callout. COUNCIL-TRANSIT is in two highlights and shows the double star (icon-multi-star); MINISTER-RESIGNS (Politics desk output, outside this crop) shows a single star (scripts/apps/search/components/HighlightsInfo.tsx). Stars are red because the items changed today, inside the time window of 'Top Stories'. Monitoring view must be List view. The seeded highlights stay until the next snapshot restore.

notes: New shot. The route ends up as #/workspace/highlights?highlight=<Top Stories id>. The list is ArticlesListByQueryWithFilters (scripts/core/ArticlesListByQueryWithFilters.tsx) with the highlight name as heading, item type buttons and the 'Create' button, which only shows with the mark_for_highlights privilege. caption: Creating a highlight configuration
preconditions: Seeded newsroom (tools/screenshots/seed.py), including highlights 'Top Stories' (now/d) and 'Election Watch' (now/w) on Politics (HIGHLIGHTS). The snapshot's 'Highlight 1' belongs to another desk.
Desks Politics, Business, World, Culture and Sports exist (seed)
steps: Open #/settings/highlights
Click the 'Create configuration' button
wait for [data-test-id="highlight-configuration-modal"] to be visible
Type 'Culture Picks' in the input with aria-label="Configuration name" inside [data-test-id="highlight-configuration-modal"]
check [data-test-id="desk-checkbox"][data-test-value="Culture"]
move the mouse away from the modal
notes: Replaces 'grafik (8).png', which must not be reused: it shows a customer's desk names. Fields: Configuration name (required, 40 characters), Template ('default template' or a highlights template), Assigned desks (one checkbox per desk), Automatically insert items from (Today, This week, Last N hours). Template: scripts/apps/highlights/views/highlights_config_modal.html. Do not save. If the Automatically insert items from select is cut off at the bottom, use a taller viewport (1440x1100).
